text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, November 4 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - One vessel loading, none waiting. 5 Vessels due by 23/11, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - Maintenance shutdown from 07.00 hrs. 4/11 to 07.00 hrs. 9/11. No vessels loading, none waiting, 21 due by 23/11. On resumption of work, up to 1 days delay expected.
Hay Point - No.2 berth closed for maintenance 7-12/11. One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 12 due by 24/11, up to 1 days delay expected prior to maintenance shutdown.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - Shutdown underway for upgrading sub-station due to be completed 19.00 hrs. 4/11. Two vessels loading, 4 waiting, 18 due by 30/11, approx. 2-3 days delay expected.
Barney Point - Major shutdown for upgrading plant and equipment due to be completed 10/11. No vessels loading, none waiting, 5 due by 29/11. No delays expected on resumption of work.
Brisbane - No vessels loading, none waiting, 3 due 29/11, no delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Dykes 4+5 - 2 Vessels loading, 2 waiting, 14 due by 19/11, approx. 2-3 days delay expected.
Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 3 waiting, 12 due by 19/11, approx. 2-3 days delay expected. Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 13 due by 26/11, up to 1 days delay expected.
IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Dampier - Parker Point - 1 vessel anchored, 2 due by 7/11.

East Intercourse island - 1 Vessel due 7/11, 13 due by 23/11 of which 11 for Parker Point, 2 for East Intercourse Island. Main-tenance shutdown at East Intercourse Island from 13.00 hrs. 10 november for five days.
Port Walcott - One vessel loading, 1 waiting at berth, 8 due by 23/11.
Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) A berth - 1 Vessel berthed, 3 anchored, 4 due by 13/11. B berth - 1 Vessel loading, 2 anchored, 2 due by 8/11, 4 others due by 20/11.
Loadsworthy (Finucane Island) - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 2 due by 10/11.
November 6 - GRAIN - QUEENSLAND - Mackay - Two vessels due by 13/11, both to load wheat.
Gladstone - One vessel loading wheat, 3 due by 26/11, all to load wheat.
Brisbane - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat, 5 due by 17/11 of which 4 to load wheat, 1 barley.
Newcastle - Four vessels due by 10/12, all to load wheat.
Sydney - No further grain loading expected at this port.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading wheat, 6 due by December, all to load wheat.
VICTORIA - Geelong - Four vessels due by 14/11 of which 2 to load peas, 1 oats, 1 wheat.
Portland - No vessels due.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat.
Port Adelaide - One vessel due 9/11 to load wheat.
Thevenard, Ardrossan, Port Giles - No vessels due.
Port Lincoln - One vessel loading wheat, 2 due by 14/11, both to load wheat.
Wallaroo - One vessel eta 11/11 to load wheat.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - One vessel loading wheat, 3 due by 17/11 of which 1 to load lupins, 2 wheat.
Kwinana - Two vessels loading wheat, 9 due by 3/12, all to load wheat.
Albany - One vessel due 7/11 to load wheat.
Esperance - No vessels due.
